pull_requests.title: feat(import): reuse complete ticketflow application with verified workflows
pull_requests.body:
Imports the complete committed application from `nvtank/ticketflow-aws` at `91833bcc0048b596c2dbf7e9dc25358c77541daf`, by explicit owner request. The branch starts from V2 main, fixing the unrelated-history problem of the earlier orphan simulation branch. Original branches remain preserved; no force-push is used.

Includes Next.js/NestJS/PostgreSQL/Prisma event lifecycle, inventory, atomic booking/orders, payment adapters, signed tickets, staff check-in, analytics, optional source features and their tests. Replaces the earlier prototype modules/migrations. Use the new isolated Compose database; do not apply this migration history to the old prototype database.

Validation performed on 2026-11-02:
- Lint, typecheck, format and full API/web build PASS.
- 130 unit tests and 106 PostgreSQL/Redis integration tests PASS.
- 54 browser E2E tests PASS: 20 foundation, 30 across 8 suites × 2 viewport runs, and 4 additional 320px checks.
- Audit: 0 high/critical after same-major body-parser/multer patches; 4 moderate and 1 low remain.
- Ten source migrations applied on the separate test database at port 55443; no unrelated database was changed.

Adaptations: V2 web/API ports 3100/4100, isolated development/test ports, three requested account roles and V2 links, current CI action versions, explicit optional Nix browser path, and stale E2E selectors aligned to the imported current navigation while retaining keyboard/focus/error-state assertions.

The 20 functional import commits allocate author/date metadata to the requested roles/W1–W9 dates and are explicitly labelled SIMULATED IMPORT. Actual import/adaptation actor is authenticated `nvtank`; source provenance and hashes are retained. This is not a claim of original authorship or historical execution. Current Project metrics will use actual GitHub timestamps, never these reconstructed commit dates.

Refs #8, #9, #10, #11, #12, #13, #14, #15, #16, #18, #19, #20, #21, #22, #23, #24, #25, #27, #28, #29, #30, #31, #32, #33, #34, #35, #41. Acceptance of mixed governance/cloud/UAT issues is not claimed. No paid AWS resource, public deployment or live payment was executed.

Owner explicitly authorized creating and merging this PR after green required CI with temporary approval count zero. No human peer approval is claimed. See `docs/reference/import-validation/RESULTS.json` and `docs/reference/ROLE_TIMELINE_MAP.json`.

pull_requests.title: feat(auth): add session rotation, replay defense and tenant access
pull_requests.body:
Implements register/login/refresh/logout/me with salted scrypt passwords, CUSTOMER-only registration, short-lived issuer/audience-checked JWTs and DB-backed session revocation. Refresh tokens are random, stored hashed, rotated under a session row lock; replay revocation commits before returning 401. Cookie operations enforce exact Origin and HttpOnly/SameSite (Secure in production). Organization context reads current membership; exceptions never expose raw Prisma/runtime errors. Adds local-only synthetic four-role seed.

Refs #11, #12, #41. Actual author `nvtank`, assigned backend DRI `TuanAn0311`; no other identity is impersonated.

Validation: lint/typecheck/build/format PASS; 9 unit tests PASS; 8 real HTTP/PostgreSQL/Redis integration tests PASS. Tests include concurrent refresh, replay revocation, forged/expired JWT, wrong issuer/audience, logout, disabled/expired sessions, extra-role registration denial and cross-organization denial. Local synthetic seed ran successfully with a generated password that was not printed. See `docs/qlda/evidence/auth-checks.json`.

Owner temporarily waived mandatory other-member approval on 2026-11-02; PR and required green quality CI remain. Records the actual policy change without claiming a human approval or formal course CCB sign-off. No browser UI/E2E, public deployment, live payment or stakeholder acceptance is claimed.

pull_requests.title: feat(foundation): add Nest API, identity schema and real dependency tests
pull_requests.body:
Adds the first independently implemented P0 API foundation: strict pnpm workspace/shared schemas, NestJS, PostgreSQL/Prisma identity/organization/session migration, safe environment validation, security headers/CORS, liveness and DB/Redis readiness, isolated Docker test services and PR quality CI.

Refs #7, #8, #9, #10, #11. These Issues include additional work and remain open. This PR is stacked on governance PR #46; merge #46 only after independent approval, then retarget this PR to main.

Validation (2026-11-02): lint/typecheck/build/format PASS; 7 unit tests PASS; migration deployed to isolated PostgreSQL; 2 actual HTTP/DB/Redis integration tests PASS including 503 when Redis disconnects. Python governance validators PASS; live backlog rerun reused 45 Issues with no duplicates. Dependency audit: 0 high/critical, 1 moderate transitive minimatch tooling advisory. See `docs/qlda/evidence/foundation-checks.json`.

Initial local checks exposed missing NixOS Prisma engine, incompatible tool versions and sandbox loopback denial; these were resolved and checks rerun. Node 24 and an explicit Nix schema-engine were used locally; CI uses standard Linux. Updated dependencies address identified high/critical advisories; no forced incompatible minimatch major override.

Limits: no Next.js UI/browser E2E yet, no seed accounts, business auth endpoints not part of this foundation, no AWS/HTTPS/live payment or stakeholder acceptance. Production rollout remains gated. Actual author `nvtank`; planned backend DRI `TuanAn0311`, independent reviewer requested. No merge without approval/green CI.
